title: La Agente \'Optima: Towards Agentic Self-Driving Laboratories
abstract: arXiv:2609.04564v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Self-driving laboratories (SDLs) combine automated experimentation with adaptive decision-making to accelerate scientific discovery. Their operation nevertheless often depends on human specialists who translate scientific objectives into executable closed-loop campaigns. Specialists adjust them as data and operating conditions change. Here, we present La Agente \'Optima, an agentic framework that constructs and supervises Bayesian optimization campaigns across computational and experimental systems while maintaining a persistent optimization state. By separating large language model (LLM) reasoning from executed campaigns, \'Optima runs repetitive optimization loops consistently, returns control to the agent only when progress requires interpretation or campaign revision, and keeps every decision auditable. translated_title: La Agente Óptima：迈向智能体驱动的自动驾驶实验室
translated_abstract: 自动驾驶实验室通过将自动化实验与自适应决策相结合来加速科学发现。然而，其运行通常依赖于人类专家将科学目标转化为可执行的闭环优化活动，并且随着数据和运行条件的变化，专家还需不断对这些活动进行调整。在本文中，我们提出了 La Agente Óptima，这是一个智能体框架，能够在计算系统和实验系统上构建并监督贝叶斯优化活动，同时维护持久的优化状态。通过将大语言模型（LLM）的推理与实际执行的活动相分离，Óptima 能够一致地运行重复性的优化循环，仅在进展需要解释或活动需要修订时才将控制权交还给智能体，并确保每一个决策都可审计。我们通过消融实验、五个数字发现任务和两个物理平台对 Óptima 进行了评估。在整个评估过程中，Óptima 保持……
tldr: La Agente Óptima 是一个将大语言模型推理与贝叶斯优化执行相分离的智能体框架，能够自主构建并监督跨计算与实验系统的闭环优化活动，从而减少对人类专家的依赖，同时保持所有决策可审计。
en_tdlr: La Agente Óptima is an agentic framework that decouples LLM reasoning from Bayesian optimization execution, autonomously constructing and supervising optimization campaigns across computational and experimental systems to reduce reliance on human specialists while keeping every decision auditable.
